senses.gloss: referring to (the blood) which made him a proselyte (circumcision).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:13">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵃ</cite> top <he>ולא הוון אלא א׳</he> his visions as to bloodshed had reference only to that (blood) which made him &c.; v. <cite ref="C00474"><he>גּוּר</he></cite>.
